summary.text: "备" is used for “prepare,” “be ready or complete,” and “equipment.” Its modern visible split is 夂 above 田, but that split is not established as its historical construction. Traditional 備 is interpreted either as a person carrying a container or, in another account, as a whole container holding arrows.

formation.text: The formation of the entry graph 备 is unresolved. A book account says it was fixed as a whole graph from a cursive form of a sound-bearing element, but the inspected page does not identify that form as 夂 or 田 or establish how it relates to the current visible split. For traditional 備, the received analysis divides it into 人 and 𤰈 and assigns 𤰈 a sound role; one interpretation also sees arrows in a container in 𤰈. The received analysis of 𤰈 itself instead says it means ‘具’ and is formed from 用 and an abbreviated 茍. A distinct analysis treats a bronze form of 備 as a whole container holding arrows, rather than as that internal split. The book also proposes a person carrying a container but leaves its quoted phonetic graph unidentified. These traditional analyses do not settle the formation of simplified 备.

components.text: This is the visible upper portion of modern 备, grouped as 夂. A book account says simplified 备 was fixed as a whole graph from a cursive form of 備’s sound-bearing element, but does not identify that form as 夂. “Go to the field” is a mnemonic, not evidence of historical meaning.

This is the visible lower portion of modern 备, grouped as 田. A book account says simplified 备 was fixed as a whole graph from a cursive form of 備’s sound-bearing element, but does not identify that form as 田. “Field” is a mnemonic, not evidence of historical meaning.

In one interpretation of traditional 備, 人 depicts a person carrying a container. Another account also proposes a person carrying a container but leaves its quoted phonetic graph unidentified; a distinct interpretation reads a bronze form as a whole container holding arrows.

In the received analysis of traditional 備, 𤰈 is assigned a sound role. CUHK also interprets it as arrows in a container, while the received analysis of 𤰈 itself gives a different account of its construction. The sound role is reported but not independently verified by historical pronunciation evidence.

sound_limitation.text: The modern Mandarin match does not establish the historical sound relation; no independent historical pronunciation for 𤰈 was verified.

sound.text: Both 𤰈 and 備 are read bèi in modern Mandarin. This present-day match is compatible with the received sound analysis but does not verify its historical basis.

history.text: 備 is recorded in oracle-bone, bronze, and manuscript script categories. These categories do not establish the graph’s earliest appearance or a dated sequence among the forms.

A book account describes graphic changes from Western Zhou through Warring States and seal forms, then says the later regular 備 retained 人 while its sound-bearing structure became obscured. Its printed sequence includes rare forms that cannot be safely identified from the scan, so they should not be equated with 夂, 田, or 𤰈. The book says simplified 备 took a cursive form of the sound element as the whole graph, but the scan does not identify that cursive form as today’s upper or lower portion; the exact relationship to the current shape remains unresolved.
The 1956 simplification scheme standardized 备 as corresponding to 備. 俻 is documented as a variant of 備, but the proposed derivation of 备 specifically from 俻 is not established.

uncertainties.text: The person-carrying-a-quiver interpretation links 備 with readiness but does not establish the word’s earliest meaning. 備 is also reported as a whole-graph sound-based borrowing for 箙, ‘quiver,’ in a bronze inscription; this means the graph was reused for a different word because of sound similarity, but the pictured container’s original name and pronunciation are unrecovered, so that proposed match cannot be verified.

Reported uses include ‘prepared’ or ‘complete,’ ‘for use,’ ‘cautious,’ ‘equipment,’ and ‘all’ or ‘entirely.’ The cited examples do not establish a complete chronology or a continuous development among these meanings.

senses.text: The current dictionary records 备 for 预备/准备 (‘prepare’). Earlier reported uses of 備 include ‘for use’; the available evidence does not establish that these uses form a dated sequence.
The current dictionary records 备 for 具备/完备 (‘have; complete’). Reported bronze uses of 備 are glossed ‘equipped’ or ‘complete’; their relation and chronology are not established here.

senses.period: received lexicographic tradition; date of spoken sense unresolved
senses.text: The received dictionary tradition records ‘cautious’ or ‘careful’; the supplied evidence does not establish this use as current.
Dictionary citations include uses glossed ‘all’ or ‘entirely’; the supplied evidence does not establish this use as current or date its emergence.
The current dictionary records 备 for 设备 (‘equipment’). Cited examples also use 備 for equipment or facilities; the evidence does not establish a particular path from earlier meanings.

limitations.text: The earliest attested spoken sense is unresolved. Reported bronze contexts and received dictionary glosses do not provide a complete dated history of the meanings.

A bronze inscription reportedly reuses 備 as a written sign for 箙, ‘quiver.’ This is proposed whole-graph sound-based borrowing: the graph was reused to write a different word, not because its meaning developed into ‘quiver.’ The depicted container’s original name and pronunciation are unrecovered, so the proposed sound match cannot be demonstrated.

overview.text: “备” means “prepare,” “be ready or complete,” and “equipment.” Its visible split is 夂 above 田, but these modern parts do not establish how the character was historically formed.

components.text: 夂 is the visible upper part of modern 备; its historical role here is unresolved.
田 is the visible lower part of modern 备; its historical role here is unresolved.
